tbesh_html:
1) to decay, pine away, rot, fester
1a) (Niphal)
1a1) to fester (of wounds)
1a2) to rot, rot away
1a3) to moulder away
1a4) to pine away
1b) (Hiphil) to cause to rot

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish
strongs_1890.kjv_def: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.
